author: missfuzzypaws
body:
HI, my name is missfuzzypaws hence my username but i was wondering if i can apply for staff. i went through the forums and found staff applications but found nothing :i i have been playing minecraft for about 2-3 years i think i'm great at park our and pvp but that can change. I do not care what place i'm put into but i well love to help around avic making it a better and a non hacker place making it fair for other players to have fun. I'm gladly be put into any category like i said before. if you don't accept my application that's fine i will be just regular girl playing avic like anyone else. and if you were wondering yes i do help around a couple servers through building and many more! (of course not the popular servers :P). i love to help members through troubles and etc.If you were wondering yes i do go to school but i can try playing everyday i know many of the members of avic play avic and help so no worries :D.No i do not have rank but i will love to have one in the future. i love frolicking through many servers but avic is one of my favorite servers. Hypixel and Mineplex are very unique servers but don't have many fun games like avic does i love the mini games mix,destroy and death match. no i do not own Skype but i do own discord which you guys(avic) has. i love the staff reminding players about the rules to avic and being fare with others. this is my applications and i hope you likes my application. :D

btw your server is the best! <3

Sincerely Missfuzzypaws
